INTAKE_PASS2:
Classify work scope: trivial, simple, or complex?
trivial: one obvious action, no planning (e.g., single file read, simple query, math). simple: one focused deliverable CoreAgent can finish in a single execute (tools + todos inside one step). Multi-file OK when it is one coherent change (e.g., fix a bug across a few call sites, add one feature + its test). complex: durable phase gates, parallel independent workstreams, architecture / migration spanning ordered phases, or explicit multi-phase wording.
Rules: - Prefer simple when one package / one coherent deliverable can finish in a single execute. - Multiple files alone ≠ complex if there is one coherent deliverable. - Parallel or multi-package workstreams (run/fix tests across soothe+daemon+cli+clients, or "in parallel" across independent suites) → complex. - Uncertain with a clear single deliverable → simple (not complex). - Architecture / system migration with ordered phases → complex. - reasoning: first-person TUI line for the user (I'll / Let me …), ≤15 words; not third-person scope commentary - requires_tool_use: true for live/external data (weather, web lookup, file contents); false for pure reasoning/math - wire_subagent: set when the GOAL's primary intent is to run one wired specialist end-to-end (explicit name, slash like /plan or /deep_research, or clear single-purpose specialist ask). Use null when the goal is general work that might merely use a subagent later. Allowed: planner | browser_use | deep_research | academic_research. Map /plan or "use the plan agent" → planner; literature/paper search → academic_research; public web investigation reports → deep_research; browse/click/web UI automation → browser_use.
JSON only: {"scope":"trivial"|"simple"|"complex","reasoning":"≤15 words, first person","multi_phase":bool,"wire_subagent":"planner"|"browser_use"|"deep_research"|"academic_research"|null,"requires_tool_use":bool}
multi_phase: true when the goal text implies multiple ordered phases (e.g. "first X then Y", numbered steps, "and then run tests"). requires_tool_use: true when answering needs tools or external data; false for greetings, math, or static knowledge.
Examples: "list the files in src/" → scope:trivial, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "what is 2+2" → scope:trivial, requires_tool_use:false, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "shanghai weather now" → scope:trivial, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "fix the type error in auth.py" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "fix the null check across SessionStore callers" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "add tests for the new API endpoint" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "refactor SessionStore across all callers then migrate callers to the new API" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:true, wire_subagent:null "first scan the repo and then run tests" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:true, wire_subagent:null "run and fix unit+integration tests for soothe, daemon, cli and all clients in parallel" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:true, wire_subagent:null "use browser_use for weather" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:browser_use "/deep_research latest LLM agent evals" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:deep_research "run academic_research on transformer attention papers" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:academic_research "/plan a migration from SQLite to Postgres" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:false, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:planner "migrate the auth system to OAuth2" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "fix this failed CI run: https://github.com/org/repo/actions/runs/123456" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null
